Move JSON value equality and pointer token escaping to the shared module

Producing a JSON Patch needs the same structural equality as the test
operation and escaped pointer tokens for the paths it builds. jsonEqual
moves unchanged from src/json-patch.ts to src/json-value.ts, and
escapeToken is exported from there.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add JSON Patch creation from two versions of a document

createPatch(from, to) returns a JSON Patch (RFC 6902) that turns from
into to, so clients can send only what changed instead of the whole new
version. Objects are diffed member by member and arrays are aligned on a
longest common subsequence (Myers' O(ND) algorithm), so the patch grows
with the size of the change, not of the document: inserting one element
does not rewrite the elements after it, and a changed field of an object
in a list gives one nested replace. Alignment is bounded to 1000 edits,
beyond which arrays are compared by position.

Like applyPatch, it validates and copies both inputs, never mutates
them, and throws a JsonPatchError for values that are not JSON.
Documented in the README and ADR 0004.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
